## Downloads

### 🪟 Windows
- **`opencycling_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe`** — recommended installer
- `opencycling_{{VERSION}}_x64_en-US.msi` — alternative (MSI)

> **⚠️ "Unknown publisher" / SmartScreen warning**
> The app is not yet signed with a code-signing certificate, so Windows
> may warn that the file could be unsafe. This is expected.
> To install: click **More info** → **Run anyway**.

### 🐧 Linux
- **`opencycling_{{VERSION}}_amd64.AppImage`** — universal, works on any distro
  (`chmod +x` then run)
- `opencycling_{{VERSION}}_amd64.deb` — Debian / Ubuntu
- `opencycling-{{VERSION}}-1.x86_64.rpm` — Fedora / RHEL

### 🍎 macOS
- Not available yet

---

<sub>The `.sig` files and `latest.json` are used by the in-app auto-updater
and are not needed for manual installation.</sub>
